name: Grade 10 Biology: Photosynthesis
subject: Biology
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to write the word equation for photosynthesis
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to state the conditions necessary for photosynthesis
learningActivities: Discussion: where do plants get their food?
Demonstration: teacher uses a leaf diagram to explain photosynthesis
Group work: learners write the word equation and list the conditions
Application: learners explain why photosynthesis is important to life
keyPoints: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants make their own food
Word equation: carbon dioxide + water -> glucose + oxygen (in the presence of light and chlorophyll)
Conditions: sunlight, chlorophyll, carbon dioxide, water
commonMisconceptions: Thinking plants get food from the soil
Forgetting that light and chlorophyll are necessary for photosynthesis
lessonEvaluation: Learners write the word equation and state the conditions for photosynthesis.
teacherReflection: Good grasp of the process. Practical on testing for starch next lesson.
